mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicate broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 105.0 during late-cycle expansion signals supply-side disruption, reducing corporate profits and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO <105.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of macro regime.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting hawkish monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL monthly change >0.3%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) over the past month indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) during recessionary conditions signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 declines during recession, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
